lines.en: Lesson 9
lines.zh: 第9课

lines.en: Flying cats
lines.zh: 会飞的猫

lines.en: How do cats try to protect themselves when falling from great heights?
lines.zh: 猫从高处跌落时如何保护自己？

lines.en: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.
lines.zh: 猫总是能吸引人类。

lines.en: They can be friendly and affectionate towards humans, but they lead mysterious lives of their own as well.
lines.zh: 它们可以对人类友好和亲热，但它们也有自己的神秘生活。

lines.en: They never become submissive like dogs and horses.
lines.zh: 它们从不像狗和马那样变得顺从。

lines.en: As a result, humans have learned to respect feline independence.
lines.zh: 结果，人类学会了尊重猫的独立性。

lines.en: Most cats remain suspicious of humans all their lives.
lines.zh: 大多数猫一生都对人类保持警惕。

lines.en: One of the things that fascinates us most about cats is the popular belief that they have nine lives.
lines.zh: 关于猫最吸引我们的一点是，人们普遍认为它们有九条命。

lines.en: Apparently, there is a good deal of truth in this idea.
lines.zh: 显然，这种说法有相当多的真实性。

lines.en: A cat's ability to survive falls is based on fact.
lines.zh: 猫从高处跌落后幸存的能力是有事实依据的。

lines.en: Recently the New York Animal Medical Centre made a study of 132 cats over a period of five months.
lines.zh: 最近，纽约动物医疗中心对132只猫进行了为期五个月的研究。

lines.en: All these cats had one experience in common: they had fallen off high buildings,
lines.zh: 所有这些猫都有一个共同的经历：它们都从高楼上跌落过，

lines.en: yet only eight of them died from shock or injuries.
lines.zh: 然而只有八只死于休克或受伤。

lines.en: Of course, New York is the ideal place for such an interesting study, because there is no shortage of tall buildings.
lines.zh: 当然，纽约是进行这项有趣研究的理想地点，因为那里不缺少高楼大厦。

lines.en: There are plenty of high-rise windowsills to fall from!
lines.zh: 有很多高层窗台可供跌落！

lines.en: One cat, Sabrina, fell 32 storeys, yet only suffered from a broken tooth.
lines.zh: 一只名叫萨布丽娜的猫从32层楼高的地方摔下，却只受了牙齿折断的伤。

lines.en: 'Cats behave like well-trained paratroopers,' a doctor said.
lines.zh: “猫的行为就像训练有素的伞兵，”一位医生说。

lines.en: It seems that the further cats fall, the less they are likely to injure themselves.
lines.zh: 猫似乎跌落得越远，受伤的可能性就越小。

lines.en: In a long drop, they reach speeds of 60 miles an hour and more.
lines.zh: 在长距离跌落中，它们的速度可达每小时60英里甚至更高。

lines.en: At high speeds, falling cats have time to relax.
lines.zh: 在高速跌落时，猫有时间放松。

lines.en: They stretch out their legs like flying squirrels.
lines.zh: 它们像飞鼠一样伸展四肢。

lines.en: This increases their air-resistance and reduces the shock of impact when they hit the ground.
lines.zh: 这增加了它们的空气阻力，并减少了它们撞击地面时的冲击。
